pages.text: $(item)White Point Stars$() come from White Point ore in the Overworld, deep underground and in the Nether. Lighting a portal with one uses it up.$(br2)They are also the key to the strongest gear there is: tools and armour roughly two and a half times as tough as netherite.
$(item)Residue$() is boiled down from liquid metalertanium, nether stars and netherite. It's the upgrade material, and repairs the gear.

The $(item)Upgrade Smithing Template$() takes the three upgrade templates, four armour trim templates and two White Point Stars. Like vanilla templates it's used up, but it can be copied.$(br2)At a smithing table, the template, any $(item)metalertanium$() tool or armour piece and a Residue give its White Point Star version, keeping its enchantments.

pages.title: Starlight
pages.text: White Point Star armour glows with a faint white light: brighter the more pieces you wear. It can be trimmed, and a White Point Star itself makes a trim material.
